name: veh_ref_speed_calc
comment: Wheel-speed -> vehicle reference-speed processor. Computes ref speed (0.125 km/h/bit) from 4 wheel speeds (median/avg), clamps to +-0x7ff. HARDCODES the 15 km/h ACC/ECD speed gate: @0xd1bc/0xd1c8 cmp Rn,#0x78 (=120=15.0 km/h) with 25 km/h engage (0xc8) hysteresis, driving flag_speed_status bit2.

name: can_tx_scheduler
comment: CAN TX scheduler: iterates message-object descriptors and calls can_tx_dispatch per message.

name: arm_thumb_call_veneer
comment: ARM<->Thumb interworking call veneer (mov r12,r4; bx r12) — NOT the CAN packer. Generic __gnu-style veneer.

name: com_signal_compose
comment: Generic COM composer: unpacks internal status words into per-signal RAM bytes incl the ESP_05 signal bytes esp05_sig_* (0x405e81-98). Table/pointer driven.

name: esp_msg_pack_525c
comment: Reads ESP_05 signal bytes 0x405e89-96; computes derived availability signals + packs/transmits.

name: esp_msg_pack_3458
comment: Reads ESP_05 signal bytes 0x405e82/84/85/86 (low signals).

name: status_assembler_5b38c
comment: Consumer of flag_speed_status (0x403f9e); status/availability assembly.

name: status_consumer_64ce4
comment: Reads flag_speed_status (0x403f9e).

name: status_assembler_474bc
comment: Reads flag_speed_status (0x403f9e); assembles a status byte from many flags.

name: veh_motion_struct
comment: Vehicle-motion struct base (DAT_0000a88c/a890 group). +0x76 = veh_ref_speed (0.125 km/h).

name: veh_ref_speed
comment: Vehicle reference speed, signed, 0.125 km/h/bit (veh_motion_struct+0x76). Written by veh_ref_speed_calc.

name: flag_speed_status
comment: Vehicle-speed status flag byte (DAT_0000a890). bit2 = speed-above-threshold hysteresis: SET >25 km/h (0xc8), CLEAR <15 km/h (0x78). Set/cleared in veh_ref_speed_calc @0xd1ac/0xd1b4/0xd238.

name: wheel_speed_0
comment: Wheel speed array 0 (DAT_0000a8c0 base; +0x2a0 = validity word, bit23).

name: wheel_speed_1
comment: Wheel speed array 1 (DAT_0000a8bc).

name: wheel_speed_2
comment: Wheel speed array 2 (DAT_0000a8b8).

name: wheel_speed_3
comment: Wheel speed array 3 (DAT_0000a8b4).

name: esp05_sig_base
comment: ESP_05 (CAN 0x106) per-signal storage base (0x405e81-0x405e98). ECD_nicht_verfuegbar=byte4 bit1. Written by com_signal_compose.

name: can_msgtab_esp05_group
comment: CAN message->descriptor table group containing {id=0x106,ptr=0x86ab} (ESP_05).

name: can_id_array
comment: Flat u32 array of all CAN message IDs the ESP handles (message-index -> id). 0x106 @0xafb08.

name: esp05_status_route_a6c8
comment: Wrapper -> FUN_0009c8c0 generic COM copy; routes app status into the ESP_05 status source struct esp05_status_src (0x405f68).

name: com_signal_route_copy
comment: Generic COM signal copy/route (dest,src,len). Populates signal buffers from application status vars.

name: esp05_status_src
comment: ESP_05 byte4-status SOURCE struct. com_signal_compose reads +0..+6 (0x405f68-6e) and unpacks bits into esp05 sig bytes. +5 (0x405f6d) bit4 -> esp05 sig 0x405e90.

name: esp05_sig_0x405e90
comment: ESP_05 signal byte = bit4 of esp05_status_src+5 (0x405f6d). Candidate ECD_nicht_verfuegbar (byte4 bit1) — NOT byte-level confirmed (pack bit-map undecoded).

name: ecd_speed_gate
comment: THE 15 km/h ECD gate (drives ECD_nicht_verfuegbar). Reads axle_speed_front(0x4022a2)+axle_speed_rear(0x402482) in 0.125 km/h/bit. Guard: if esp_ctrl_status.bit12 clear (or the substate/fault guards fail) -> clear flag_ecd_speed_avail immediately. Else: when BOTH speeds < 0x78 (=15.0 km/h; cmp @0x845fc/0x84608), count ecd_avail_debounce down from 0x1e(30) then CLEAR flag_ecd_speed_avail bit6; when either >= 0x78, reload debounce and keep the flag. ROUTE MAPPING: this is what makes ECD_nicht_verfuegbar flip 0->1 at exactly 15.0-15.2 km/h -> both the ~2s cutoff (car decelerates through 15) and the non-engagement (request arrives already <15).

name: flag_ecd_speed_avail
comment: ECD speed-available flag byte. bit6 (0x40) = vehicle speed >= 15 km/h (clean threshold w/ ~30-cycle debounce, NO 25 km/h hysteresis). Written by ecd_speed_gate (0x844fc); gates ecd_decel_pressure_calc (0x6de38).

name: ecd_decel_pressure_calc
comment: Comfort-ECD (mode-2) pressure executor. Sets ecd_ctrl_struct(0x403a14) phase timing {0x14,5,3,7}; loads a default ramp 300/300/500/0x834/0xc80/8000 into ecd_setpoint_struct(0x403d8c)+8..+0x12. THE GATE: `if ((*flag_ecd_speed_avail & 0x40)==0)` (speed<15 km/h) -> ZEROS setpoints +8/+0xa/+0xc/+0x14 => comfort braking releases below 15. Else looks up ecd_pressure_curve(0xaeb60) via interp_lookup indexed by ecd_decel_request_mag(0x403a7c), applies a 500-unit floor when ecd_decel_reference < -0x8d, and peak-tracks the 6 setpoints. This is the ONLY reader of flag_ecd_speed_avail -> the mode-4 ANB executor is NOT gated here.

name: axle_speed_a
comment: Axle/wheel speed A (signed 0.125 km/h/bit) compared to 0x78=15km/h in ecd_speed_gate.

name: axle_speed_b
comment: Axle/wheel speed B (signed 0.125 km/h/bit) compared to 0x78=15km/h in ecd_speed_gate.

name: decel_req_preprocess
comment: Decel-request input stage: for each of 4 sources, extrapolates value between CAN frames: out = raw - (staleness*gradient)>>2 (staleness=3-(ctr&3)). Comfort src (type2) is a DIRECT copy (no extrapolation). Writes 0x405a90/94/a0/ac.

name: decel_req_assemble
comment: Assembles up to 4 typed decel requests into the arbitration array (12B each). type=1/2/4/5; each gated by state_byte==0x10 (0x405dcd) + enable bit 0x80. Type2 carries extra fields (comfort ECD).

name: decel_req_arbitrate
comment: Decel arbitrator (MAX-wins). Scans the typed request array twice: primary max on field+0 -> decel_arb_output+0x10, secondary max on field+8 (raw values) -> +0x12. Writes the winning request TYPE byte straight to ecd_mode (0x405aba) -- so type==mode (type4=emergency, type2=comfort). SECONDARY-PREEMPT: when (decel_frame_counter&3)==0 and the secondary winning type changed, sets flag +0x3b bit0x20 and overrides the primary with the secondary (raw) request. Highest deceleration always wins regardless of source.

name: decel_ctrl_top
comment: Top deceleration controller: count=decel_req_assemble(); decel_req_arbitrate(); clamp result to [min,0x3ffe].

name: ecd_state_machine
comment: ECD/brake control state machine. Dispatches on ecd_mode (0x405aba) + substate (0x403e2a): mode2/sub2 -> ecd_decel_pressure_calc (smooth); mode4 -> FUN_000a15d0->ecd_emergency_pressure (flat); other substates set fixed pressure profiles/ramps. Calls ecd_speed_gate first.

name: ecd_emergency_pressure
comment: EMERGENCY/mode-4 pressure handler (ACC_10/ANB-class). Sets ALL 6 pressure setpoints to the SAME requested value (FLAT step, no ramp) + fixed timing {0x14,10,3,7}. Does NOT check flag_ecd_speed_avail -> works below 15 km/h but ROUGH (bang-bang vs the comfort ramp).

name: ecd_mode
comment: ECD control mode = winning decel-request type (1/2/4/5) from decel_req_arbitrate. Selects smooth-comfort vs flat-emergency pressure in ecd_state_machine.

name: decel_req_array
comment: Arbitration input: 4 preprocessed decel requests (type1@+0,type2/comfort@+4,type4@+0x10,type5@+0x1c). Written by decel_req_preprocess.

name: can_msg_cfg_ACC_10
comment: Record #13 of can_msg_cfg_table = CAN id 0x117 (ACC_10). timeout_pair=0x0005000a, flags=0x010a0000, state_ram=0x404588. PROVES the B8 Q5 ESP8 receives ACC_10 -- corrects the earlier claim that only the ESP9 handled it.

name: can_id_group_table
comment: 110 records, stride 6: {u16 0xff00, u16 can_id, u16 group}. Contains 0x117 (group 0x144). Purpose of the group field not yet established.

name: can_id_list_b
comment: Second flat u32 CAN-id list (~210 entries, ids <=0x7ff), includes 0x117. Distinct from can_id_array at 0xafae0.

name: decel_req_preprocess_srcs
comment: Literal pool of decel_req_preprocess: status array 0x405dcd, source buffers 0x403fac / 0x403a40 / 0x407bb4 / 0x403d76, output 0x405a90, scratch 0x405a7c, frame counter 0x400804.

name: decel_src_comfort
comment: Decel-request source 1 -- the DIRECT-COPY source (no inter-frame extrapolation), written by decel_src_comfort_calc (0x88a88) and consumed by decel_req_preprocess/decel_req_assemble.

name: decel_src_comfort_calc
comment: Computes decel_src_comfort (0x403a40) from inputs 0x403a80/0x403a86 (raw values), 0x403ab8 (flag bytes) and 0x403a2e (status word), with a gain from 0x40545c and a limit pair +-0x8000/0x7fff. 0x403a86 is also read by ecd_speed_gate (0x846cc).

name: mem_copy
comment: memcpy(dest,src,len) - generic byte copy used throughout the COM signal plumbing.

name: decel_type4_scale
comment: Type-4 decel-request scaling/gain stage (uses interp thunk 0x58f94); writes the type4 current value 0x407bac. Upstream of the double-buffer + extrapolation. Part of the deep processing chain between CAN decode and the decel arbitration.

name: com_decel_double_buffer
comment: COM double-buffer stage for the decel/ECD signal groups: mem_copy(current,staging,len) per group. Its literal pool IS the staging->current map; the entry (dst 0x403a7c, src 0x403a6c, len 0x10) is what writes 0x403a80/0x403a86, the inputs of decel_src_comfort_calc.

name: decel_stage_writer
comment: Writes the decel staging block 0x403a70/72/74/76 (which com_decel_double_buffer then copies to 0x403a7c..0x403a8c). Inputs: 0x405462 (CAN-side signal), 0x403a48, 0x403ab4, 0x403ddc. The 0x405462 producer is the remaining unknown link to the CAN frame.

name: decel_req_assemble_types
comment: Literal-pool map for decel_req_assemble. Four gated sources, each requires status 0x405dcd[i]==0x10 + enable bit0x80 + value>0, tagged with a TYPE that becomes ecd_mode: slot A value 0x405a90 aux decel_src_type1(0x403fac) -> type1; slot B value 0x405a94 aux decel_src_comfort(0x403a40) + flag byte 0x403a36 -> type2 (comfort/ECD, speed-gated); slot C value 0x405aa0 aux decel_src_type4(0x407bb4=ANB) -> type4 (emergency, NOT speed-gated); slot D value 0x405aac aux decel_src_type5(0x403d76) -> type5.

name: variant_cfg_select
comment: Startup variant selector: on a code of 6/10/0x10/0x11 it stores per-variant FLASH calibration block pointers into 0x40081c/0x400820/0x400824/0x400828/0x40082c. 0x40081c is therefore a calibration base pointer (read all over, e.g. veh_ref_speed_calc, decel_src_comfort_calc +0x11c) -- NOT a CAN buffer.

name: can_msg_cfg_table
comment: CAN message config table: 223 records x0x14 {u32 can_id,u32 timeout_pair,u32 mode/timeout,u32 shared_routine,u32 state_ram}. Handles ACC_10(0x117,rec#13,state 0x404588) + 213 raw-signal msgs. SEPARATE from the 0xafae0 cluster (ESP_01-05/TSK/ACC_01/ACC_05). So the ESP receives BOTH ACC_10 (here) and ACC_05 (0xafae0).

name: can_rx_indication
comment: Generic CAN RX indication: copies received frame payload into the record's state_ram buffer (called indirectly via can_msg_cfg_table field-4 with record ptr). Signal extraction is done later by table-driven consumers.

name: acc10_rx_state
comment: ACC_10 (0x117) reception state/buffer (can_msg_cfg_table rec#13 state_ram). Raw ANB frame lands here; ANB_Zielbrems extracted downstream (table-indirect).

name: anb_decel_request_build
comment: ANB/emergency (type-4) request state machine + executor. MULTI-CYCLE LATCHED: idles (init->reset, anb_status_word bit31) until the recomputed decel demand anb_decel_magnitude(0x4066e0) >= 0x461, which arms it (bit28) -- EMULATION-VERIFIED (emu/exp_anb6.py), and this arm is gated by the DECEL MAGNITUDE, not the freigabe bit (freigabe 0x40553b bit3 only sets sub-bit5). Also needs master-enable 0x405cac==0x10 (init default), quality 0x4055b4>0xc, counter 0x4055e4<0x37, 0x405abe in{0,4}, no fault, 4-wheel plausibility. Computes decel via ecd_pressure_curve; drives per-wheel ECD substates {0x13,0x16,0x11}. Its committed output reaches the arbitration source 0x407bb4 + enable 0x407bbb + status 0x405dcd[2] via COM status gateways (decel_src_status_gateway 0x9d9f8, com_decel_double_buffer) whose sources are memcpy-fed (COM-indirect).

name: ecd_emergency_dispatch
comment: Thin wrapper -> ecd_emergency_pressure (0x9c788). Called by ecd_state_machine when ecd_mode==4 (emergency/ANB).

name: veh_ref_wheel_estimator
comment: Per-wheel deceleration/reference estimator. Maintains a 5-tap history shift-register, averages, calls FUN_0005ed78 x4 (per wheel, offsets +0x534/+0x562), clamps at 0x76. Writes the 0x40545c/0x405460 word (comfort-gain + CAN-side decel input). NOT a CAN request itself -- a measured internal quantity.

name: decel_mode_state_set
comment: Sets the 0x405460 channel value + mode byte (+0xc/+0xd): mode=1 when request active (status flags 0x404bbc nonzero), mode=4 on fault after >0x27 (39) stale ticks, mode=0 idle. Value from a rolling-average block scaled x0x4000>>0x10; threshold 0x310 default (or 0x405460-calib) with -0x83 hysteresis (bit0x40).

name: com_pdu_router_9546e
comment: AUTOSAR COM PDU handler (message handle<0xd, PDU id 0x3d). Part of the index-driven signal-extraction layer invoked after can_rx_indication -- extracts packed signals from a message's state_ram into per-signal buffers. This is the indirection that hides the CAN-id -> decel-source binding from static xref.

name: decel_src_type4
comment: Type-4 (ANB/emergency) decel source. Written by anb_decel_request_build (0x4bf3c); read by decel_req_preprocess(->0x405aa0) and decel_req_assemble which tags it type=4. type==mode identity => drives ecd_mode=4 => ecd_emergency_pressure, which does NOT read flag_ecd_speed_avail => brakes below 15 km/h (flat/bang-bang).

name: decel_src_type1
comment: Type-1 decel source (raw). Gated by status 0x405dcd[6]==0x10 + enable 0x403fac[7]&0x80. Assembled to slot 0x405a90, tagged type=1.

name: decel_src_type5
comment: Type-5 decel source (raw). Gated by status 0x405dcd[0]==0x10. Assembled to slot 0x405aac, tagged type=5.

name: decel_arb_output
comment: decel_req_arbitrate output/scratch struct (DAT_00094b80). +0x10 primary max decel, +0x12 secondary max, +0x36 secondary winning type, +0x37 prev secondary type, +0x39 winner flag, +0x3b flags (bit0x20=secondary-preempt-armed). Winning TYPE byte is written separately to ecd_mode 0x405aba.

name: decel_frame_counter
comment: COM frame counter (DAT read as &3). Drives decel_req_preprocess slew staleness (3-(ctr&3)) AND the decel_req_arbitrate secondary-preempt gate ((ctr&3)==0).

name: decel_stage_can_input
comment: CAN-side decel input half-word read by decel_stage_writer (0x57044). Low half of the 0x405460 word written by veh_ref_wheel_estimator (0x5ee10) and decel_mode_state_set (0x8c1e8).

name: anb_decel_jerk_shaper
comment: Jerk/rate-limited ANB decel-target shaper. Filters the raw target with coeffs 0xd/0x7f and 0x111, clamps via PTR_FUN_000761bc/DAT_000761c0, writes 0x407906 (the value anb_decel_request_build consumes). FUN_00076152 resets its state when PTR_DAT_000761f0==1.

name: decel_hold_escalation_mgr
comment: POST-arbitration request shaper/hold manager. Operates on decel_arb_output (0x405a7c) + ecd_mode neighbourhood (writes 0x405ab8/0x405abb). Reads all four type status bytes -- type1 0x403fb3, type2 0x403a37, type4/ANB 0x407bbb, type5 0x403d7d -- with &4/&2 masks and ESCALATES the active request to a 'type 3' hold state; rate-limits (0x2d/0x7f), clamps 0x500/0x80/0x3ffe.

name: ecd_pressure_setpoints
comment: The 6 ECD brake-pressure setpoints (0x403d94[0..5]). ecd_emergency_pressure writes all 6 = the SAME ANB request value (flat); the comfort executor writes a 6-point ramp. Consumed by the pressure/valve controller via ecd control struct 0x403a14+8.

name: anb_request_struct
comment: ANB request output struct (built by anb_decel_request_build). +6 (0x407c0a) = the requested decel/pressure value that ecd_emergency_pressure broadcasts to all 6 setpoints.

name: decel_type4_enable
comment: Type-4 (ANB/emergency) enable/status byte = decel_src_type4+7. assemble gates the ANB request on bit0x80 here AND status 0x405dcd[2]==0x10. Written by the status-assembler layer (computed-address), not a single static writer.

name: decel_type1_status
comment: Type-1 request status byte (read by decel_hold_escalation_mgr with &4/&2).

name: decel_type5_status
comment: Type-5 request status byte (read by decel_hold_escalation_mgr with &4/&2).

name: ecd_actuation_pipeline
comment: ECD actuation pipeline dispatcher (param_1=ECD ctrl struct 0x403a14). Calls the 8 hydraulic control substeps in order: FUN_000a2a0c (if +0x5a<0), FUN_000a1088, FUN_000a252c, FUN_000a2158, FUN_000a1f54, FUN_000a2090, FUN_000a1f7c, FUN_0009dc8c. This is the stage between the 6 pressure setpoints and the wheel valve/pump drivers.

name: ecd_ctrl_struct_init
comment: Initializes the ECD control struct 0x403a14: [+0]=6 (slot count), [+8]=setpoint-array ptr (points into the 6-setpoint block), [+0x10]=secondary ptr. Confirms 0x403a14 layout.

name: ecd_prefill_gate
comment: ECD pre-fill/enable gate. Writes the request's +0xd0 field = 0x14 (pre-charge) or 0 based on wheel-pressure demand (+0x11c/+0x11e/+0x120/+0x122), speed (+0x3c), and mode (+0x14c). Runs before the pressure pipeline.

name: can_msg_state_ram_base
comment: Base of the per-message 4-byte state slots for the 0xa9fc0 config table: state_ram(i) = 0x404554 + 4*i. ACC_10 (rec#13) = 0x404588. Holds per-message status/handle, NOT the frame payload.

name: ecd_ctrl_struct
comment: ECD control struct (DAT for state machine/executors/pipeline). [+0]=slot count(6), [+8]=ptr to 6 pressure setpoints (0x403d94), [+0x10]=secondary ptr, [+0x10..0x13]=phase timing bytes, [+0x1a..]=per-phase pressures. Consumed by ecd_actuation_pipeline (0x9f190).

name: interp_lookup
comment: Kennlinie/curve interpolation lookup helper (x, table_ptr) -> interpolated y. Used pervasively (14x in the pressure stages alone) for accel->pressure/gain maps.

name: mul_div_scale
comment: Fixed-point multiply/divide/scale helper (a,b)->result in r0, remainder/second in r1 (extraout_r1). Ubiquitous in the decel/pressure math.

name: ecd_press_stage_slew
comment: ECD pressure substep 1 (via wrapper 0xa252c): PT1 slew of the pressure command (coeff 0x330/0x33, >>8/>>0xc). Operates on the ECD ctrl struct.

name: ecd_press_stage_anb
comment: ECD pressure substep 2 (via wrapper 0xa2158): ANB-branch pressure control math; gain curves via interp_lookup, clamps +-0x2800.

name: ecd_press_stage_track
comment: ECD pressure substep 3 (via wrapper 0xa1f54): pressure tracking vs measured wheel pressure (+0x76 ref, +0x44/+0x46 per-corner).

name: ecd_press_stage_ctrl
comment: ECD pressure substep 4 (via wrapper 0xa2090): main wheel-pressure controller -- PT1 (coeff 0xd130/0xd13 >>0xd) + gain-curve output. Produces the per-wheel pressure/valve demand.

name: ecd_press_stage_state
comment: ECD pressure substep 5 (via wrapper 0xa1f7c): pressure phase/state manager (+0x13 mode 1/2/3, +0x41/+0x42 edge, +0x43 flags). Sequences apply/hold/release.

name: ecd_mode_sync
comment: ECD mode-state sync (pipeline tail): reconciles request mode (+0x50) into the actuation mode byte (+0x18=1/2/0x10) and mirrors to +0x3e. Gate before the pressure stages commit.

name: com_signal_commit
comment: AUTOSAR COM signal-group COMMIT primitive (critical section via software_interrupt 3/2). descriptor{[0]=value,[3]=bit-index,[4]=dest-buf,[5]=len,[2]=src}; copies src->dest+8 for len bytes and sets the group's ready mask. The low-level signal write.

name: com_group_ready
comment: AUTOSAR COM signal-group READY check: (*(com_sig_group_table[grp*0x18 + 0x10] + 8) & mask@+4)==mask. grp id passed in (e.g. 0x3d in com_pdu_router).

name: com_sig_group_table
comment: COM signal-group config base (DAT_00050110), indexed grp*0x18. Nested/variable-length descriptor stream: {+4=ready_mask, +0x10=status_ptr, embedded {tag,count,buffer_ptr} signal descriptors}. Signal buffers point into 0x407c-range (ANB/ACC) and 0x406c-range. This is the CAN<->signal routing table.

name: com_pdu_descriptor
comment: Per-signal descriptor array used by com_pdu_router (stride 0x14): {status_ptr, src, dst, buf, bitmask}; ptrs decrement by 1 per successive bit/signal.

name: com_sig_group_table_ptr
comment: Pointer to com_sig_group_table (0xb6a44); base for the grp*0x18 index in com_group_ready.

name: esp_ctrl_status
comment: ESP control-status word. bit12(0x1000) = ECD/ANB subsystem armed & plausible -- ecd_speed_gate's first guard: if clear, ECD is declared unavailable immediately (no braking).

name: ecd_substate
comment: ECD state-machine substate (companion to ecd_mode 0x405aba). Read by ecd_state_machine dispatch and ecd_speed_gate guard.

name: ecd_decel_request_mag
comment: ECD deceleration-request magnitude (the comfort/ANB target). Used by ecd_speed_gate as a plausibility input AND by ecd_decel_pressure_calc as the index into the pressure calibration curve ecd_pressure_curve.

name: ecd_decel_reference
comment: ECD measured/reference deceleration. Threshold `< -0x8d` gates a 500-unit minimum pressure floor in ecd_decel_pressure_calc and a plausibility branch in ecd_speed_gate.

name: ecd_gate_flags
comment: ECD gating flags byte; ecd_speed_gate tests `& 0x12` (fault/inhibit bits) before allowing the availability flag to stay set.

name: ecd_avail_debounce
comment: Debounce counter (byte) for flag_ecd_speed_avail. Reloaded to 0x1e=30 cycles when speed>=15; must count to 0 below 15 before the flag is cleared -> the ~0.5s lag between crossing 15 km/h and brake release seen in the route.

name: ecd_setpoint_struct
comment: ECD pressure-setpoint struct base. Setpoints live at +8..+0x12 (= ecd_pressure_setpoints 0x403d94..0x403d9e), 6 x s16. ecd_decel_pressure_calc fills a default ramp 300/300/500/0x834/0xc80/8000 then peak-tracks -- or ZEROS +8/+0xa/+0xc when flag_ecd_speed_avail is clear.

name: ecd_pressure_curve
comment: Calibration Kennlinie (flash) mapping ECD decel request -> brake pressure, read via interp_lookup in ecd_decel_pressure_calc. The accel->pressure transfer function for the comfort ECD path.

name: anb_gate_status
comment: ANB/ECD gate status byte; ecd_speed_gate guard input (`& 0x40` with a ==2 substate check).

name: p_ecd_ctrl_struct
comment: ptr literal -> ecd_ctrl_struct (0x403a14)

name: p_ecd_setpoint_struct
comment: ptr literal -> ecd_setpoint_struct (0x403d8c)

name: p_flag_ecd_speed_avail
comment: ptr literal -> flag_ecd_speed_avail (0x403da9) -- the 15km/h gate flag

name: p_ecd_decel_request_mag
comment: ptr literal -> ecd_decel_request_mag (0x403a7c)

name: p_ecd_pressure_curve
comment: ptr literal -> ecd_pressure_curve (0xaeb60)

name: p_ecd_decel_reference
comment: ptr literal -> ecd_decel_reference (0x4075a4)

name: p_esp_ctrl_status
comment: ptr literal -> esp_ctrl_status (0x403a04)

name: p_ecd_mode_sg
comment: ptr literal -> ecd_mode (0x403aba)

name: p_ecd_substate_sg
comment: ptr literal -> ecd_substate (0x403e2a)

name: p_ecd_comfort_decel_in
comment: ptr literal -> 0x403a86 (comfort decel input)

name: p_anb_gate_status

name: anb_signal_conditioning
comment: ANB request conditioning/plausibility stage. Reads conditioned signal buffers (0x40559c,0x405474,...) + 4-wheel validity (0x401394/0x401f7c/0x401988/0x400da0 all-negative check); writes the ANB decel-request source 0x4054c4 and freigabe gate 0x40553b (both consumed downstream by the ANB builder). NOT the raw ACC_10 unpacker -- operates on already-extracted signals.

name: anb_decel_from_wheels
comment: Computes the ANB arm-gate magnitude 0x4066e0 (anb_decel_request_build >=0x461 gate). CORRECTED 2026-08-23: it is NOT purely wheel-derived -- it reads an EXTERNAL request input 0x4054c4 (DAT_7c418, clamped +-0x1ff) AND a second input 0x4085ce (DAT_7c424) AND per-wheel dynamics (0x402590+0x566 x4), and writes 0x4066e0 (DAT_7c434). 0x4054c4 is produced by anb_signal_conditioning(0x3bf58) from received-signal conditioning (radar_msg_signal_proc 0x2c554 etc.). => the emergency/ANB arm IS externally influenced (external request is a primary term, combined with vehicle dynamics). Prior claim does not pass through a received signal / wheel-only was WRONG. Exact source CAN ID/field NOT statically pinnable (runtime COM routing, computed-address; conditioning mixes internal+received). DBC ACC_10.ANB_Zielbrems is the strongest candidate, unproven.

name: radar_msg_signal_proc
comment: Signal processor writing many conditioned buffers incl ANB gate inputs 0x40553b,0x4055b4,0x40559c. Assembles a 16-bit value from byte pair (0x405xxx). One stage of the multi-stage COM->plausibility chain feeding the ANB gates.

name: anb_subsystem_init
comment: ANB subsystem INITIALIZER: writes a large struct block to defaults (=1, =0x10, =2), incl the master-enable 0x405cad=0x10. Proves 0x405cac==0x10 is an init-default 'available' state, NOT an internal decision blocker.

name: com_signal_delayline
comment: 1-cycle delay-line: shifts a block [n]=[n+1] (0x405cac = delayed copy of 0x405cad, etc.). Provides prev-cycle values for edge-detection in the ANB/COM logic.

name: com_signal_commit_wrapper
comment: Per-signal-group COM commit: builds a descriptor at the 0x18-stride signal table (base+8+idx*0x18) with value from base[idx*4], then calls com_signal_commit. param=signal-group index.

name: anb_decel_request_src
comment: ANB decel-request source (written by anb_signal_conditioning 0x3bf58; consumed by anb_decel_from_wheels 0x7c1d4). Post-conditioning, pre-wheel-recompute.

name: anb_decel_magnitude
comment: ANB decel magnitude fed to anb_decel_request_build; the >=0x461 enable-gate input. Computed by anb_decel_from_wheels (0x7c1d4) from wheel dynamics + request.

name: anb_master_enable
comment: ANB master-enable gate (anb_decel_request_build needs ==0x10). Init-default 0x10 (anb_subsystem_init); 1-cycle delay of 0x405cad. NOT a hard internal blocker.

name: decel_src_status_gateway
comment: Byte-shuffle gateway: copies a source status block (0x405d1b) into the decel-source status array (0x405dcc/0x405dcd) in reordered order. type-4 active status 0x405dcd[2] = source[1] (0x405d1c). One of the COM-style commit gateways between the ANB builder's active state and the arbitration eligibility.

name: anb_status_word
comment: ANB builder (0x4bf3c) latched state-machine word (psVar14+0x16). Top nibble = 4-stage state: bit31=idle/reset, bit28=active/armed. Masks 0x80001000/0x80801000/0x40403000/0x20209000/0x1010c000 latch exit/release states. bit5=freigabe(0x40553b bit3), bit6=freigabe-debounce. EMULATION-VERIFIED: arms (bit31->bit28) when decel demand 0x4066e0 >= 0x461, independent of freigabe.

name: anb_active_latch
comment: Byte 2 of anb_status_word (0x407bf0). Nonzero = ANB state latched active (skips re-init). Only set nonzero by the release-state masks; the machine idles (init->reset loop) until the decel threshold arms it.

name: anb_target_filter
comment: PT1 filter/conditioner on the ANB target deceleration. NOT a CAN-message converter (corrected 2026-08-23, adversarial re-trace + verified single-writer): reads INTERNAL input 0x407894 (computed by FUN_0007da34 from ANB working values, no frame-RAM read) and in-place PT1-filters accumulator 0x40926c toward it (`0x40926c += (0x407894-0x40926c)>>3`), then interp+calib (flash 0xaf250, limit 0x4e20) -> ANB target region 0x407904/0x4078fa/0x4078a8/0x4078f0 -> anb_decel_jerk_shaper(0x75f34). Gated by 0x405538==1. 0x40926c/0x40926e are PRIVATE filter state (only writer = this fn @0x8392c/0x83948), NOT received CAN buffers. The ANB decel target is internally/wheel-derived (see anb_decel_from_wheels 0x7c1d4), not passed from any received radar message.

name: anb_target_filter_state
comment: PT1 filter accumulator, PRIVATE to anb_target_filter (0x8390c) -- read+written ONLY there (EspRefsRange: single writer @0x8392c). Tracks internal input 0x407894 at coeff 1/8. NOT a received CAN signal (earlier anb_can_target_signal / ACC_10.ANB_Zielbrems label was WRONG -- it is a filter state, not an RX buffer; corrected 2026-08-23).

name: anb_enable_flag
comment: ANB/vehicle-state enable flag (anb_target_filter gates on ==1). Set from INTERNAL substate by FUN_0007cb88 (struct bytes +0x10a/+0x80), read by ~19 fns incl veh_ref_speed_calc -- a general state flag, NOT received-radar-message-valid (earlier anb_can_msg_valid label was WRONG; corrected 2026-08-23).
